claims.sentence: NICE published its osteoporosis risk assessment guideline, NG259, on 29 July 2026.
NG259 replaces the earlier guideline CG146 and is the first part of a wider update.
The second part, on treatment and monitoring, is still in development.
NICE published a new guideline, Osteoporosis: risk assessment (NG259), on 29 July 2026.
It replaces guideline CG146 and is the first part of a wider update.
NICE says it covers fragility fracture risk assessment, identifying vertebral fragility fractures, deciding whether drug treatment is appropriate, and follow-up for people not having treatment.
The second part of the update, on treatment and monitoring, is still in development.
A fragility fracture is a broken bone caused by a fall from standing height or less.
